title: 4521-ESP-AGE-21-70-0001 R1
summary:
- This document is an instrument specification for the project 'Solana'.
- It includes details on alternate billing cycles and confidentiality.
- The scope of work involves supplying instruments, cables, gaskets, etc.
- Supplier must adhere to all attached specifications and deliver materials to designated locations.
- Confidential information cannot be used or disclosed without permission.
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles.
- Confidential and proprietary information.
- Material must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards.
- Vendor data required for project progress.
- Quotation must include time for approval drawings and fabrication.
- Equipment to be delivered at purchaser's site with specific locations.
- Strict delivery schedule by June 2012.
